## Problem and result

Describe what changed and how the behavior improves. Distinguish implemented behavior from proposed design.

## Validation

List commands run, results, and material limitations. Link any changed worked examples.

## Review focus

Call out business assumptions, data-contract changes, and decisions needing reviewer attention.

- [ ] No real business records, secrets, or model weights included
- [ ] Expected calculations checked independently when changed
- [ ] Relevant documentation updated

Reviewer selection and merging are handled by the repository owner.
